title: 3449. Maximize the Minimum Game Score

examples.explanation: Initially, index i = -1 and gameScore = [0, 0]. Move Index gameScore Increase i 0 [2, 0] Increase i 1 [2, 4] Decrease i 0 [4, 4] The minimum value in gameScore is 4, and this is the maximum possible minimum among all configurations. Hence, 4 is the output.

Initially, index i = -1 and gameScore = [0, 0, 0]. Move Index gameScore Increase i 0 [1, 0, 0] Increase i 1 [1, 2, 0] Decrease i 0 [2, 2, 0] Increase i 1 [2, 4, 0] Increase i 2 [2, 4, 3] The minimum value in gameScore is 2, and this is the maximum possible minimum among all configurations. Hence, 2 is the output.
